run_densepose_inference: run densepose_inference to split predictor outputs into per-image chunks and attach them to detection Instances
review_densepose_inference: review densepose_inference which slices tensor fields from a dataclass predictor output by detection count per image
test_densepose_inference: test densepose_inference with mock dataclass predictor output and a list of detectron2 Instances objects
refactor_densepose_inference: refactor densepose_inference to support non-dataclass predictor output types beyond the current dataclass assumption
summarize_densepose_inference: summarize densepose_inference which distributes batched DensePose predictor tensors across per-image detection Instances
